title: 醫技系鏡檢課專用教學資源
description: 本區為醫學檢驗暨生物技術學系鏡檢課專用教學資源。Web-CASA Lite 提供精子活動力鏡檢練習：上傳顯微鏡影片後，由瀏覽器本機執行精子頭部候選辨識、運動軌跡追蹤及 VCL、VSL、VAP、LIN、STR 等 CASA 參數估算，協助理解前進運動（PR）、非前進運動（NP）與不活動（IM）的判讀概念。軟體仍為教學驗證原型，結果可能受影像品質及雜質影響，僅供課堂練習與方法展示，不作臨床診斷依據。
description_en: Dedicated teaching resources for the Department of Medical Laboratory Science and Biotechnology microscopy course. Web-CASA Lite provides browser-based sperm motility practice using uploaded microscope videos, candidate sperm-head detection, trajectory tracking, and estimated CASA metrics (VCL, VSL, VAP, LIN, STR). It introduces PR, NP and IM motility concepts. This is an experimental educational prototype; results are not validated for clinical use.

materials.title: Web-CASA Lite｜精子活動力自動分析教學網站（實驗原型）
materials.title_en: Web-CASA Lite — Sperm Motility Teaching Tool (Experimental Prototype)

title: 醫技系臨床微生物學實驗｜互動教學工具
description: 陽明交通大學醫學檢驗暨生物技術學系之臨床微生物實驗教學資源。Web-CFU Lite 可在手機或電腦上傳培養皿照片，使用瀏覽器自動圈選菌落，並以觸控手動新增或刪除誤判標記；定量培養時可輸入稀釋度及接種體積練習 CFU/mL 計算。現階段為教學驗證原型，仍需人工核對，結果不作為臨床檢驗或正式研究數據。
description_en: An interactive resource for NYCU medical laboratory science clinical microbiology teaching. Web-CFU Lite provides on-device colony detection in plate photographs, touch-based manual corrections, and a dilution-plating CFU/mL calculator. The tool is an experimental educational prototype and requires manual verification.

materials.title: Web-CFU Lite｜培養皿菌落自動計數與 CFU/mL 計算（教學原型）
materials.title_en: Web-CFU Lite — Colony Counting and CFU/mL Calculator

title: 醫技系臨床血液學與鏡檢｜白血球分類教學工具
title_en: Clinical Hematology & Microscopy — WBC Differential Training
description: 醫學檢驗暨生物技術學系臨床血液學及鏡檢教學專用。Web-WBC Lite 提供五類成熟白血球（NEU、LYM、MON、EOS、BAS）的形態重點、PBC 專家標註細胞影像分類練習、100-cell differential、混淆矩陣與錯題回顧，以及學生自行上傳血液抹片照片進行人工計數。PBC 遠端影像需網路連線，另提供明確標示的形態示意圖練習。僅供教學，不作臨床診斷。
description_en: An educational WBC differential tool for NYCU medical laboratory science. Learn morphology of five mature WBC classes and practice 100-cell classification with PBC expert-labelled single-cell images, answer review, confusion matrices, and manual counting on locally selected blood smear photos. PBC images require external data access; separately labelled schematic practice is available. For education only.

materials.title: Web-WBC Lite｜白血球分類與 100-Cell Differential（教學原型）
materials.title_en: Web-WBC Lite — WBC Morphology and 100-Cell Differential Practice
